networking.description: Design and troubleshoot the plumbing that connects everything: virtual networks, gateways, and DNS.

compute-storage.label: Compute & Storage

security-fundamentals.label: Security Fundamentals

containers.label: Containers & Kubernetes

cicd.label: CI/CD & Automation
cicd.description: Automate builds, tests, and deployments so shipping code is boring — in a good way.

monitoring-cost.label: Monitoring & Cost Management
monitoring-cost.description: Know what's running, what it costs, and get alerted before something breaks.

az-104.label: AZ-104 · Azure Administrator
az-104.description: The certification that ties it all together: governance, identity, and day-to-day Azure administration.

company-tools-setup.label: Company Tools & Systems
company-tools-setup.description: Get every account, channel, and system dialed in before day one is even over.

itsm-basics.label: IT Service Management Basics
itsm-basics.description: Learn how requests, incidents, and changes flow through the organization — and why the process exists.

incident-management.label: Incident Management
incident-management.description: When something breaks, know how to triage it, escalate it, and write it up afterward.

monitoring-alerting.label: Monitoring & Alerting
monitoring-alerting.description: Read dashboards fluently and know what an alert is actually telling you to do.

scripting-automation.label: Scripting & Automation Basics
scripting-automation.description: Turn repetitive manual work into a script — your future self will thank you.

documentation.label: Documentation & Runbooks

communication-escalation.label: Communication & Escalation
communication-escalation.description: Say the right thing to the right person at the right time — especially when things are on fire.

continuous-improvement.label: Continuous Improvement
continuous-improvement.description: Look back at what happened, find the pattern, and make the process better next time.

support-tools-setup.label: Support Tools Setup
support-tools-setup.description: Get your helpdesk software, ticketing system, and knowledge base ready before the first ticket lands.

customer-communication.label: Customer Communication Basics
customer-communication.description: Learn to write and speak in a way that calms people down instead of winding them up.

ticket-triage-support.label: Ticket Triage & Prioritization
ticket-triage-support.description: Figure out what's urgent, what can wait, and who else needs to know.

product-knowledge-support.label: Product Knowledge for Support
product-knowledge-support.description: Build a mental map of the product so you can answer the top questions from memory.

troubleshooting-diagnostics.label: Troubleshooting & Diagnostics
troubleshooting-diagnostics.description: Go beyond the FAQ — read logs, reproduce bugs, and track down the actual root cause.

escalation-collaboration.label: Escalation & Cross-Team Collaboration
escalation-collaboration.description: Know when to hand a ticket off to engineering, and how to do it without losing context.

customer-satisfaction.description: Understand what CSAT and response-time targets actually measure — and how your work moves them.

first-solo-shift.label: First Solo Shift

qa-fundamentals.label: QA Fundamentals
qa-fundamentals.description: Understand where testing fits in the software lifecycle and why bugs are cheaper to catch early.

manual-testing.label: Manual Testing
manual-testing.description: Write test plans, explore the product like a curious user, and report what you find clearly.

bug-tracking.label: Bug Tracking & Triage
bug-tracking.description: File bugs that developers can actually act on — clear steps, clear severity, no guesswork.

api-testing.label: API Testing
api-testing.description: Test the layer users never see: requests, responses, status codes, and edge cases.

automation-fundamentals.label: Automation Fundamentals
automation-fundamentals.description: Turn your best manual tests into scripts that run themselves, every time.

performance-testing.label: Performance & Load Testing
performance-testing.description: Find out how the system behaves under real pressure, before your users do.

cicd-for-qa.label: CI/CD & Test Pipelines
cicd-for-qa.description: Wire your tests into the pipeline so broken code gets caught before it ships.

first-qa-rotation.label: First QA Rotation
first-qa-rotation.description: Own test coverage for a real release, alongside a mentor who's done it before.

dev-environment-setup.label: Dev Environment Setup
dev-environment-setup.description: Get Git, your editor, and local tooling configured so you can actually start writing code.

programming-fundamentals.label: Programming Fundamentals
programming-fundamentals.description: The building blocks that don't change no matter what language or framework you land on.

web-fundamentals.label: Web Fundamentals
web-fundamentals.description: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — how a page actually gets built and behaves in a browser.

backend-basics.label: Backend Basics
backend-basics.description: APIs, databases, and authentication — the parts of an app users never see but always depend on.

testing-code-quality.label: Testing & Code Quality
testing-code-quality.description: Write code that's easy to trust: tests, reviews, and a linter that has your back.

version-control-workflows.label: Version Control Workflows
version-control-workflows.description: Branch, open a pull request, and survive your first merge conflict without panicking.

cicd-deployment.label: CI/CD & Deployment
cicd-deployment.description: Understand how code goes from your laptop to production — and how to roll it back if it doesn't.

first-feature-ship.label: First Feature Shipped
first-feature-ship.description: Take a real ticket from breakdown to production, with a pair and a reviewer alongside you.

product-onboarding.label: Product & Company Onboarding
product-onboarding.description: Learn what we sell, who we sell it to, and why they should care.

crm-fundamentals.label: CRM Fundamentals

prospecting.label: Prospecting & Lead Generation
prospecting.description: Find the right people to talk to before you ever pick up the phone.

sales-calls-demos.label: Sales Calls & Demos
sales-calls-demos.description: Run a discovery call and a demo that actually answers 'why should I care?'

negotiation-closing.label: Negotiation & Closing
negotiation-closing.description: Handle pricing pushback and objections without giving away the deal.

account-management.label: Account Management
account-management.description: What happens after the deal closes: renewals, handoffs, and keeping customers happy.

sales-metrics.label: Sales Metrics & Reporting
sales-metrics.description: Understand the numbers that define whether a quarter went well — and why.

first-deal-closed.label: First Deal Closed
first-deal-closed.description: Run a real deal start to finish, with a mentor checking in along the way.
